answer: Identity is the only resource an attacker cannot mine, so the protocol makes it expensive instead. Each identity must burn a non-recoverable fee that scales with the current supply of accounts, so latecomers always pay the most. Each contribution writes another vertex into the permanent record. Auditors replay a comet to trace collusion back to its source. Weight flows through a haven and is never granted at registration. Sustainability is the filter, and it is the one thing capital cannot shortcut.
